div.head: List of Short Titles
div.p: Acheson, Present at the Creation: Dean Acheson, Present at the Creation: My Years in the State Department, New York: W.W. Norton Company, Inc., 1969.
Adenauer, Erinnerungen: Konrad Adenauer, Erinnerungen, 1953–1955, Stuttgart: Deutsche Verlangs-Anstalt, 1968.
Adenauer, Memoirs: Konrad Adenauer, Memoirs, 1949–1953, translated by Beate Ruhm von Oppen, Chicago: Henry Regnery Company, 1966.
AFP: United States Department of State, American Foreign Policy, 1950–1955, Basic Documents, 2 vols., Washington: Government Printing Office, 1957.
Aussenpolitik der DDR: Deutsches Institut für Zeitgeschichte, Dokumente zur Aussenpolitik der Regierung der Deutschen Demokratischen Republik, Berlin: Rutten & Loening, 1954.
Berlin Discussions: United States Department of State, Foreign Mininsters Meeting, Berlin Discussions, January 25–February 18, 1954, Washington: Government Printing Office, March 1954.

Cmd. 8571: Conventions between the Governments of the United States of America, the Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland and the French Republic on the one part and the Federal Republic of Germany on the other with accompanying instruments, Bonn, 26th May, 1952, Germany No. 6 (1952), London: Her Majesty’s Stationery Office, May 1952, Cmd. 8571.

Cmd. 9080: Documents relating to the Meeting of the Foreign Ministers of France, the United Kingdom, the Soviet Union and the United States of America, Berlin, January 25–February 18, 1954, Miscellaneous No. 5 (1954), London: Her Majesty’s Stationery Office, February 1954, Cmd. 9080.
Documents on German Unity: Office of the United States High Commissioner for Germany, Documents on German Unity, 3 vols., Frankfurt and Bonn, 1951–1953.
Documents on Germany, 1944–1985: United States Department of State, Documents on Germany, 1944–1985, Washington: Government Printing Office, 1985.
Documents on the Saar: Office of the United States High Commissioner for Germany, Documents on the Saar, 2 vols., Frankfurt and Bad Godesburg, 1951 and 1952.
Documents (R.I.I.A.) for 1952: Denise Folliot, ed., Documents on International Affairs 1952, Royal Institute of International Affairs, London: Oxford University Press, 1955.
Documents (R.I.I.A.) for 1953: Denise Folliot, ed., Documents on International Affairs 1953, Royal Institute of International Affairs, London: Oxford University Press, 1956.
Documents (R.I.I.A.) for 1954: Denise Folliot, ed., Documents on International Affairs 1954, Royal Institute of International Affairs, London: Oxford University Press, 1957.

Dokumente der SED: Dokumente der Sozialistischen Einheitspartei Deutschlands: Beschlüsse und Erklärungen des Zentralkomitees sowie seines Politburos and seines Sekretariats, Berlin: Dietz Verlag; Bd. IV, 1954; Bd. V, 1956.

Dokumente zur Deutschlandpolitik der Sowjetunion: Deutsches Institut für Zeitgeschichte, Dokumente zur Deutschlandpolitik der Sowjetunion, Bd. 1, vom Potsdamer Abkomen am 2 August 1945 bis zur Erklarung uber die Herstellung der
Souveranität der Deutschen Demokratischen Republik am 25 Marz 1954, Berlin: Rutten & Loening, 1957.
Eden, Full Circle: Sir Anthony Eden, The Memoirs of Anthony Eden, Full Circle, Boston: Houghton Mifflin Company, 1960.
Germany 1947–1949: United States Department of State, Germany 1947–1949: The Story in Documents, Washington: Government Printing Office, 1950.
Grotewohl, Reden und Aufsätze: Otto Grotewohl, Im Kampf um die Einige Deutsche Demokratische Republik, Reden und Aufsätze, Bande III and IV, Berlin, 1954 and 1959.
Gruber, Between Liberation and Liberty: Karl Gruber, Between Liberation and Liberty, Austria in the Post-War World, London: Andre Deutsch, 1955.
H.C. Deb 5s: Parliamentary Debates, House of Commons, Fifth Series.

Papers and Documents: Federal Ministry for All-German Affairs, The Efforts Made by the Federal Republic of Germany to Re-establish the Unity of Germany by Means of All-German Elections, Papers and Documents, Second Enlarged Edition, Bonn, 1954.
Protokoll der II. Parteikonferenz: Protokoll der Verhandlungen der II. Parteikonferenz der Sozialistischen Einheitspartei Deutschlands, Berlin: Dietz Verlag, 1952.

Protokoll des IV. Parteitages der SED: Protokoll der Verhandlungen des IV. Parteitages der Sozialistischen Einheitspartei Deutschlands, Bd. I: 1. bis 4. Verhandlungstag; Bd. II: 5. bis 8. Verhandlungstag; Berlin: Dietz Verlag, 1954.
Ruhm von Oppen, Documents on Germany: Beate Ruhm von Oppen, ed., Documents on Germany Under Occupation, 1945–54, Royal Institute of International Affairs, London: Oxford University Press, 1955.
Schaerf, Österreichs Erneuerung 1945–1955: Adolf Schaerf, Österreichs Erneuerung 1945–1955. Das Erste Jahrzehnt Zweiten Republik, Vienna: Verlag de Wiener Volksbuchhandlung, 1955.

Senate Q and R: United States Senate, 82d Senate, 2d Session, Executives Q and R, Message from the President of the United States transmitting the Convention on Relations between the Three Powers and the Federal Republic of Germany, signed at Bonn on May 26, 1952 and a Protocol to the North Atlantic Treaty signed at Paris on May 27, 1952, Washington: Government Printing Office, June 2, 1952.
SSSR s GDR: Ministerstvo inostrannykh del SSSR i Ministerstvo inostrannykh del GDR, Otnosheniia SSSR s GDR, 1949–1955gg., Dokumenty i materialy, Moscow: Izdatel’stvo politicheskoi literatury, 1974.
Ulbricht, Die Entwicklung des Volksdemokratischen Staates: Walter Ulbricht, Die Entwicklung des Deutschen Volksdemokratischen Staates, 1945–1958, Berlin: Dietz Verlag, 1958.
Ulbricht, Zu Fragen der Parteiarbeit: Walter Ulbricht, Zu Fragen der Parteiarbeit, Berlin: Dietz Verlag, 1960.
